title: Candidate identity repair does not loosen profit or risk gates

steps: Run the same frozen strategy and configuration through the formal scanner
Inspect current_action and the gate audit
expected: Identity admission alone never produces ENTER_NOW or WAIT_FOR_ENTRY

Paper and live evidence remain separated
evidence: source/config digest comparison and fresh NO_TRADE runtime artifact
